subject: gk
question: Freedom of Conscience provided in Article 25 of the Constitution of India is strengthened by which of the following two articles?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Articles 27 and 28**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 27 guarantees freedom from taxation for religious purposes, **stating that no person shall be compelled to pay taxes for the promotion or maintenance of any religion or religious activity.
 
• **Article 28 ensures that no religious instruction** is provided in any educational institution that is wholly funded by the state.
 
• These provisions strengthen the freedom of conscience and religious freedom under Article 25
 
• It **guarantees the right to freely profess, practice, and propagate religion.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 24: **

 
 
• **​**This **article deals with the prohibition of child labour**.
 
• It states **that no child below the age of 14 years shall be employed to work in any factory** or mine or engaged in any other hazardous employment.
 
• While important for protecting children's rights, it does not directly relate to freedom of conscience or religious freedoms.
 
 
 
• **Article 26: **
 
 
• **​**This **article provides the freedom to manage religious affairs. **
 
• It **allows every religious denomination or any section thereof the right **to establish and maintain institutions for religious and charitable purposes, manage its own affairs in matters of religion, and own and acquire property.
 
• This article** strengthens religious freedom and conscience by ensuring religious groups can function independently.**
 
 
 
• **Article 29:**
 
 
• This article ensures the protection of **the cultural and educational rights of minorities.**
 
• It **states that any section of the citizens residing in India **with a distinct language, script, or culture has the right to conserve the same.
 
• It **also guarantees the right to establish and administer educational institutions,** which helps protect the identity and religious beliefs of minority groups.
